set.body: Per sojourn/docs/plans/2026-07-24-remote-executor.md Phase 3. SlurmSite.local (preflight + SlurmLocal + Managed.durable + RegisteredTaskLauncher + ResultAttachment + FsSiteStore), typed-durable erase join, outcome mapping via InterruptionClass, one-shot worker binary (SojournEntryPoint + WorkerBridge), demo assembly, gated Slurm TCK suites (18 laws, skip-with-reason absent cluster). Evidence: sojourn commit 5a68610; 57 tests green + 18 gated. REMAINS OPEN: exit proof = BatchTck+StoreTck vs tools/disposable-slurm (needs Docker daemon) + acceptance evidence record. Recorded deviations: IO-shaped slurm site (upstream worker IO-hardcoding); per-task resources = v1 SPI limitation; ReleaseStager deferred to remote/pool milestone.
